fields.label: Workflow Name
fields.description: The name operators know this campaign by.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Draft while it is being built, Published to freeze it, Active to arm it, Suspended to disarm it, Archived to retire it. New journeys start only while it is Active.

fields.label: Entry Node
fields.description: The step a journey starts at.

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: The record this campaign watches. Filled in from the trigger step.

fields.label: Event
fields.description: The moment this campaign watches for. Filled in from the trigger step.

fields.label: Trigger Mode
fields.description: The way a journey starts - a record event, or a scheduled group of patients.

fields.label: Next Cohort Run
fields.description: When this campaign's group of patients is next due. Blank for a campaign woken by a record.

fields.label: Last journey
fields.description: When a journey was last started on this campaign. It does not mean when a journey last did anything.

fields.label: Total Runs
fields.description: The number of journeys this campaign has started.

fields.label: Cohort State
fields.description: Shows Draining while a group of patients is being worked through.

fields.label: Cohort Cursor
fields.description: The last patient started, so a stopped run resumes after them rather than from the top.

fields.label: Abort Cohort
fields.description: Stops the current group at the end of the next batch. Journeys already started carry on.

fields.label: Cohort Progress At
fields.description: When the group last moved. A run that stops moving is picked up again.

fields.label: Next Batch Due
fields.description: When the next batch is due.

fields.label: Seconds Between Batches
fields.description: Overrides the site-wide pace for this campaign alone. Set it where the campaign places calls rather than messages. Blank uses Cohort Pace Settings.

fields.label: Canvas Layout (JSON)
fields.description: The position of each step on the canvas. Layout only - moving a step never changes the campaign.

fields.label: Vertical
fields.description: The product line this campaign watches. Filled in from the trigger step.

fields.label: Group
fields.description: The group this campaign watches. Filled in from the trigger step.

fields.label: Program
fields.description: The programme this campaign watches. Filled in from the trigger step.
